census_breakdown.description: Exhaustive census across APFS RootFS DMG (141-08876-216_rootfs.dmg) verifying exact containment boundaries

appclip_architecture.sandboxing_model: Ephemeral container under /private/var/mobile/Containers/Data/PluginKitPlugin/ managed with ephemeral Apple Pay and isolated Keychain access groups
invocation_vectors: Visual App Clip Codes (Circular Cam Scans)
appclip_architecture.lifecycle_behavior: Dynamic streaming download via appstored without permanent homescreen icon installation; purgeable upon memory pressure or after 30 days inactivity

light_dark_appearance_variants.mechanism: CoreUI dynamic selector binding responding to UIAccessibility and UIScreen style changes without process relaunch

tintable_monochromatic_variants.mechanism: Vector alpha masks dynamically colored by SpringBoard icon customization engine (iOS 18+ / iOS 27)

display_p3_wide_gamut.mechanism: Deep color 16-bit float and uncompressed DCI-P3 color profiles for Retina XDR displays

vector_icon_stacks.mechanism: Multi-layer vector assets supporting depth parallax and real-time ray-traced highlights in StandBy and SpringBoard

sections.description: 128 KB Thread Property Read-Only dynamic allocator

tpro_const_segment_summary.hardware_mechanism: ARM64 Thread Permission Register (TPR) on Apple Silicon t8150
tpro_const_segment_summary.lifecycle_transition: Read-Write during early dyld bootstrapping and closure generation -> Sealed to Read-Only prior to transferring execution to LC_MAIN

contrast_with_userland_memory.__DATA_CONST: Static page-table write-protection enforced by MMU after relocation fixing; does not protect dynamically allocated heap stubs
contrast_with_userland_memory.__AUTH_CONST: PAC-authenticated pointers (IB/DA keys); protects against pointer tampering but leaves heap allocator structures writable
contrast_with_userland_memory.__TPRO_CONST: Hardware register-enforced write revocation for dynamic linker allocator; immune to user-thread memory corruption
